[[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] incumbent [[Jack Reed (Rhode Island politician)|Jack Reed]] is seeking a sixth term. He is being challenged by [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] former state party committee member Raymond McKay. [[Primary elections]] were held on September 9. Reed won the Democratic nomination with 76.8% of the vote against minimal opposition. In the Republican primary, McKay ran unopposed.
